name: POKERIZE
description: Pokerize is a rummy variant in which play follows basic draw-and-discard rummy (draw one, meld sets or runs, lay off on melds, discard one) and the result or scoring is interpreted using standard poker hand rankings (high card, pair, two pair, flush, full house, etc.).

content.text: Pokerize is a rummy variant in which play follows basic draw-and-discard rummy (draw one, meld sets or runs, lay off on melds, discard one) and the result or scoring is interpreted using standard poker hand rankings (high card, pair, two pair, flush, full house, etc.).

Rummy games derive from early 20th century; theories point to Mexican Conquian or Asian origins. Pokerize applies poker hand rankings to rummy outcomes, combining rummy melding with poker-style evaluation.
One standard deck; score sheet if playing to a target score.
Deal 10 cards each for 2 players, 7 for 3–4 players, or 6 for 5–6 players, one at a time. Remaining cards form the stock; turn one card face up to start the discard pile.

items.text: Deadwood as poker hand: Only unmelded cards are evaluated as a poker hand; highest poker hand among deadwood wins or scores.
